scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 3001
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck --workspace=@video-meetings/web && cd apps/api && uv run ruff check .
scripts.api:types: cd apps/api && uv run python scripts/export_openapi.py && cd ../.. && openapi-typescript apps/api/openapi.json -o apps/web/src/api/schema.d.ts && prettier --write apps/web/src/api/schema.d.ts apps/api/openapi.json
